source.source_locator: 教則 第2章 2.1.2「役割分担の明確化」

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 技能証明保有者が複数いる場合は意図する飛行の操縦者を飛行前に明確化する。
evidence.tested_misconception: 資格保有者が複数いれば操縦責任者を事前に特定しなくてもよい。
evidence.reasoning_path: multiple qualified pilots -> responsibility ambiguity -> preflight designation

collision.note: LOW。Q089は補助者の配置・担当範囲・連絡方法。Q188は補助者の主な役割。複数技能証明保有者間の操縦者指定は未出。

independent_review.rationale: 教則2.1.2 explicitly requires preflight designation of the intended pilot when multiple skill-certificate holders are present. Q089 and Q188 concern assistant coordination/roles, not pilot responsibility designation.

director_adjudication.rationale: Director independently confirms current MLIT 第5版 support, second-class applicability, answer correctness and a non-duplicate reasoning boundary against the 188-question canonical bank.
